extension.summary: Fetch subtitles from your HolyArrs server
extension.description: Searches and saves subtitles by asking your own HolyArrs server. HolyArrs does the subtitle-site work; this add-on finds the playing file in HolyArrs by its path, lists the candidates, and asks HolyArrs to save the one you pick next to the video. Any language Kodi asks for is searched on demand, and an old subtitle HolyArrs did not save can be replaced after you confirm. Kodi and HolyArrs must see the media files at paths that end alike (shared mount).
